reply.emotion: attentive and focused, directing attention to something specific
notes: Use 'mirar' when directing your eyes or attention toward something, like looking at a picture or watching television.
Do not confuse it with 'ver', which simply means 'to see' (the physical ability or an involuntary perception) without necessarily focusing on it.

senses.definition: Dirigir los ojos hacia algo o alguien para verlos.

examples.text: Ella decidió mirar el atardecer desde el balcón.
examples.translation: She decided to look at the sunset from the balcony.
examples.emotion: peaceful and appreciative, enjoying the quiet beauty of the evening

senses.definition: Observar algo con atención durante un tiempo, como un espectáculo o la televisión.

examples.text: Nos gusta mirar películas juntos los viernes por la noche.
examples.translation: We like to watch movies together on Friday nights.
examples.emotion: cozy and relaxed, settling in for a comfortable evening

definitions: Dirigir los ojos hacia algo o alguien para verlos.
